subject: Urgent: Production server down – immediate action required
body:
Hi team,

Our production servers have been unresponsive for the last 45 minutes. Customers are receiving 503 errors. Database connections are failing. We need all hands on deck immediately.

Please join the incident bridge: https://meet.company.com/incident-bridge

– Ops Team

subject: Contract renewal – signature required by Dec 5
body:
Hi,

As discussed in our call last week, please find the updated service agreement attached for your review and signature.

Key changes:
- Contract term extended to 3 years
- Annual value increased to $240,000
- SLA uptime improved to 99.9%

We need the signed copy back by December 5th to avoid a lapse in service.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Sarah Johnson
Legal Counsel, BigClient Corp

subject: Can we reschedule Thursday's meeting?
body:
Hi,

Thanks in advance!

Mike
